# pulse_outbound_webhook (Resource)

An outbound webhook: Pulse POSTs every event matching `filter` to `url`, one at a time and in order, retrying with backoff and signing each request with HMAC-SHA256 using `secret`. Only events published after the webhook is created are delivered.

The URL must not point at private, loopback or link-local addresses unless the server allows them (`PULSE_OUTBOUND_ALLOW`). The signing secret is either set with `secret` or generated by Pulse when the webhook is created; Pulse never returns it again, so the provider keeps it in state (sensitive). Change `secret_version` to have Pulse generate a new one. Import with the webhook ID; an imported webhook has no `secret` in state until you set `secret` or change `secret_version`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Forward door events to Home Assistant. Pulse signs each request with the generated secret
# (Pulse-Signature header); change secret_version to rotate it.
resource "pulse_outbound_webhook" "home_assistant" {
  name           = "home-assistant"
  url            = "https://ha.example.com/api/webhook/pulse-doors"
  filter         = "evt.home.door.>"
  secret_version = "1"

  headers = {
    Authorization = "Bearer ${var.ha_token}"
  }
}

variable "ha_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (String) Subject filter under `evt.`, e.g. `evt.>` (everything) or `evt.home.*.created`. Wildcards: `*` matches one token, `>` (last) the rest. Changing it keeps the delivery position.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among outbound webhooks: lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 48 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
- `url` (String) Endpoint the events are POSTed to (`http` or `https`, without credentials; send those in `headers`).

### Optional

- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Extra request headers, e.g. `Authorization`. `Host`, `Content-Type`, `Content-Length` and `Pulse-*` cannot be set. Sensitive, because they usually carry credentials.
- `paused` (Boolean) Pause deliveries. Events keep queueing and are delivered after resuming. Default `false`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret (at least 16 characters). Leave it unset to have Pulse generate one (`whsec_…`) at creation; the generated value is stored in state. Changing a configured value updates it in place.
- `secret_version` (String) Arbitrary value. When `secret` is not set, changing it (including setting it for the first time, e.g. after an import) makes Pulse generate a new secret, which is stored in state. Requests are signed with the new secret from then on. Has no effect while `secret` is set.

### Read-Only

- `consumer` (String) Name of the JetStream consumer that tracks the delivery position.
- `id` (String) Webhook ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the webhook ID. The signing secret cannot be read back: set `secret`, or change `secret_version` to
# have Pulse generate a new one.
terraform import pulse_outbound_webhook.home_assistant 01jabcdefghjkmnpqrstvwxyz0
```
